info.title: API.SH: Petco
info.description: The Petco API from API.SH: public Petco data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
One petco.com product with every size or variant: name, brand, product and variant links, image, description, price, list price and autoship price, price range, rating and review count, taxonomy, categories, attributes (lifestage, flavor, breed size, dietary preference, health feature, form, weight…), store pickup, same-day delivery, autoship, in-store-only, prescription and personalization flags. Each variant has its variation id, name with size, link, image, price, list and autoship price and its own attributes. Pass a variation id or link to also get that variant as `selected_variant`.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/petco-product

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Petco product id (as in /petco/v1/search), a variation id (the number at the end of a petco.com product link) or the link itself.

get.description:
Customer questions about one petco.com product, each with its answers (text, date, nickname, brand answer and best-answer flags, helpful votes, photos), plus the product's question and answer counts. Sort by newest, oldest, most answered or most helpful; only answered questions or questions containing words. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; it is null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/petco-questions

get.description:
Customer reviews of one petco.com product with the average rating, review count, recommended and not-recommended counts, star distribution and secondary rating averages. Each review has rating, title, text, date, nickname and location, recommended flag, helpful votes, verified-purchaser and incentivized flags, badges, secondary ratings, the reviewer's pet details, photos, videos and Petco's replies. Sort by relevance, newest, oldest, highest, lowest or most helpful; filter by stars, photos or words. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; it is null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/petco-reviews

parameters.description: Petco product id (as in /petco/v1/search), a variation id (the number at the end of a petco.com product link) or the link itself.

parameters.name: rating
parameters.description: Only reviews with this many stars.

get.description:
Search the petco.com catalog by keywords, or browse a category or brand, with every filter and sort the site offers. Each product has id, variation id, name, brand, links (product and the matched size), image, description, price, list price and autoship price (or the price range across sizes), rating and review count, taxonomy, the categories it belongs to, attributes (lifestage, flavor, breed size, dietary preference, health feature…), store pickup, same-day delivery, autoship, in-store-only and prescription flags, and every size or variant with its own price and link. The response also has the filter values with counts (`facets`), matching categories and related searches. When few products contain the words, the site adds related products: `keyword_matches` and `related_matches` say how many of each. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; it is null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/petco-search

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search words. Optional when category or brand is given.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Category id from /petco/v1/categories (e.g. dry-dog-food), or a petco.com category link. Alone it browses the category; with q it narrows the search.

parameters.name: brand
parameters.description: Brand name; several separated by | (any of them).

parameters.name: filters
parameters.description: More filters as name:value pairs separated by ; (several values of one name joined by |), using the names and values in `facets`, e.g. Lifestage:Adult;Primary Flavor:Chicken|Salmon.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One Petco store: name, neighborhood, store page link, address, phone, coordinates, time zone, weekly hours, services, pickup and delivery options, description, payment options, Google place id, booking links for grooming, training, vet and vaccination appointments, events link, the store's FAQ, store attributes (accessibility, delivery…), photos and related service locations.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/petco-store

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Store number (from /petco/v1/stores) or a stores.petco.com store link.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

example.description: Petco pet store in San Diego offers pet supplies, nutrition and services including Dog Training, Vaccination Clinic in one convenient locati…

get.description:
Petco stores (including Unleashed by Petco) near a ZIP code, a city or a point, nearest first: store number, name, neighborhood, store page link, address, phone, coordinates, distance, time zone, weekly hours, in-store services (full-service grooming, dog training, vet hospital, vaccination clinic, aquatics, self-service dog wash) and pickup and delivery options. Filter by service; `services_nearby` counts each service among the matches. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; it is null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/petco-stores

parameters.name: zip
parameters.description: A 5-digit US ZIP code or a city such as San Diego, CA (or pass lat and lng instead).

parameters.name: lat
parameters.description: Latitude, with lng, instead of zip.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
